entries.template: Among {totalObjects} distinct files, files A, B and C must occupy positions 2, 4 and 6 respectively. In how many arrangements is this possible?
Among {totalObjects} distinct books, three specified books must occupy positions 1, 4 and 7 in any order. How many arrangements are possible?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct people are there at most {maximumGap} people between two particular people?
In how many arrangements of {totalObjects} distinct people does A appear before B with B exactly {positionDistance} positions after A?
Among {totalObjects} distinct people, at least {minimumInClass} of {specifiedCount} specified people must occupy odd-numbered positions. How many arrangements are possible?
